0.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_1
0.description: You have questions? Very well, ask.

6.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_2
6.description: As timbermaster of the Oak Atrium, I am responsible for all that transpires within these halls.

7.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_3
7.description: Like all destined to take up the saw, I have been fascinated with the trees of the Twelveswood since I was a child.

8.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_4
8.description: That brought me here, where I dedicated myself to practice, learning from my betters and through trial and error besides. In time, my efforts were recognized, and I was chosen to lead.

9.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_5
9.description: Some see carpenters as common craftsmen─laborers who work one wood or another into whatever form the customer demands.

10.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_6
10.description: But a carpenter must be more discerning than that. To read the lines in the lumber, to <hex:021A020203>know<hex:021A020103> the character of the tree that birthed it─<hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> is what it means to be a carpenter.

11.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_10
11.description: I presume you are asking in a philosophical sense. Very well. Carpentry is, at its core, an expression of love─a love of wood, and of what it may become.

12.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_11
12.description: To address your question more directly, carpentry is the origin of the bow, the lance, and the shield─tools any self-respecting adventurer should know. All were the creations of master carpenters.

13.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_12
13.description: A master understands the myriad characteristics of every tree in the Twelveswood. He knows the ideal wood for any given task, and has perfected the techniques needed to utilize the unique strengths of that wood.

14.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_13
14.description: Of course, such knowledge and skill would count for little without a ready supply of quality lumber, and we have the Greatloam Growery to thank for that. Were it not for the botanists, there would be no Oak Atrium─just a rabble of carpenters pining for want of a straight stick.

15.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_14
15.description: But thanks to our friends at the Growery, we can freely choose our materials, and craft goods needed by the people of Gridania. To proudly serve─<hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103> is the soul of carpentry.

16.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_20
16.description: Twelve as my witness... I will not bother speculating how you lost the mask, though I find it hard to believe it was not <hex:021A020203>intentional<hex:021A020103>.

17.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_21
17.description: See that you don't lose <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> one. Now stop wasting time and continue your quest. This minstrel's tale cannot reach its climax till all the players be assembled.

19.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_060
19.description: Well, well... How fares our fugitive?

20.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_061
20.description: Yes, I am aware of your troubles─and the questionable integrity of your accusers. Remain strong and resolute as a heavenspillar, and you shall weather this storm.

21.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_070
21.description: In returning the broken spear, you have found a new client? Well, I trust you can put to good use the tricks of the trade you learned from me.

22.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_080
22.description: Bravo, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! An adamantite trident is a rare and precious weapon, and you ought take great pride in having crafted one. In fact, word of it had reached Gridania more swiftly than you did.

23.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_081
23.description: Cemi is like a sapling. With enough care and attention she will flourish. Without it, however, she will slowly wither away.

24.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_082
24.description: Lately, I have been reminded that no matter how promising they may seem, training a new recruit requires a great deal of dedication. They are nothing like trees, which need naught but a bit of water and sunlight to thrive.

25.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_083
25.description: Gairhard has asked that I pass along his thanks to you. By your saw have his men finally learned to see eye to eye.

31.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_100
31.description: You are asking after Gairhard, I presume. We are─and ever will be─friends.

32.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_101
32.description: We had an opportunity to speak at length before his last mission, and we managed to reach an understanding.

33.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_102
33.description: ...Oh, and you will be pleased to hear that the bow you crafted has served him well.

34.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_120
34.description: I am, as ever I have been, tender caretaker of the younglings and saplings of Gridania. Yet watching you grow does make me feel my age. Mayhap I am now but an old plant, waiting to wither and die.

35.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_121
35.description: I meant that as a jest, of course. Treasures that they are, the children would suffer tremendously for my loss. As would the Twelveswood, I daresay.

36.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_122
36.description: But rest assured, I do take great pleasure in your accomplishments, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. And if I can teach others to grow as you have, all the better.

37.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_130
37.description: I have been referring clients to Cemi recently, and all of them have been absolutely delighted with her work.

38.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_131
38.description: It seems she has finally learned to put the needs of her customers first, instead of attempting to simply showcase the extent of her own abilities.

39.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_132
39.description: As I have said before and will say again, I have high hopes for the girl. I imagine that one day she might even come to rival you.

40.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_140
40.description: I was under the impression Cemi was diligently studying Eastern woodworking techniques from the local masters of Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han when she was away. This letter suggests otherwise, however. It arrived shortly before her return.

41.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_141
41.description: (-Letter from Cemi-)<hex:021A020203>Greetings, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! My apologies for not writing in so long. There's simply been so much to do since I arrived here in Thavnair, the time has absolutely flown by!<hex:021A020103>

42.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_142
42.description: (-Letter from Cemi-)<hex:021A020203>I tell you, Near Eastern culture is simply fascinating! In particular, I've become quite enamored with the local cuisine, especially the simply divine dish they call hamsa curry. You simply must try it if you haven't already! Till we meet again.<hex:02100103>Yours truly,<hex:02100103>Cemi<hex:021A020103>

43.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_143
43.description: It would seem I've been too lenient with the girl. Well, I hope she enjoyed her leisure time abroad, as she's in for a rude awakening...

44.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_110
44.description: For an accomplished carpenter such as yourself to ask that question is inconceivable. What am I to make of this inexplicable ignorance? I can only assume that you wish to educate a fledgling carpenter with my words...

45.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_111
45.description: Carpentry is, at its core, an expression of love─a love of wood, and of what it may become.

46.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_112
46.description: A master understands the myriad characteristics of every tree in the Twelveswood. He knows the ideal wood for any given task, and has perfected the techniques needed to utilize the unique strengths of that wood.

47.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_113
47.description: Such knowledge and skill would count for little without a ready supply of quality lumber, of course. But thanks to our friends at the Growery, we can freely choose our materials, and craft goods needed by the people of Gridania.

48.name: TEXT_REGFSTWDKGUILD_00029_BEATINE_000_114
48.description: ...That is, in essence, what I am certain I have told you before. Do not make me repeat myself again.
